entries.legacy_result: accepts digit groups without checking IPv4 octet bounds
entries.native_result: PIG_ADMIN_IP and PIG_HOST_IP reject invalid addresses
entries.rationale: declarations must contain real IPv4 addresses, not only IPv4-shaped text

entries.legacy_result: accepts digit groups and a one-or-two digit prefix without network bounds
entries.native_result: PIG_HBA_ADDR rejects invalid IPv4 CIDR declarations
entries.rationale: CIDR parsing uses netip so octets and prefix length are checked

entries.legacy_result: Python treats a boolean sequence as an integer
entries.native_result: PIG_SEQ_TYPE requires an actual YAML integer
entries.rationale: boolean and integer declarations are distinct YAML types

entries.legacy_result: does not compare sequence values within one module identity
entries.rationale: module sequence uniqueness is part of the IaC declaration contract

entries.legacy_result: classifies Redis groups but does not validate redis_node
entries.native_result: PIG_SEQ_TYPE validates redis_node type and range
entries.rationale: all declared module sequences use the same deterministic safety rule

entries.legacy_result: prints a service field type error but leaves the success flag unchanged
entries.native_result: PIG_SERVICE_FIELD_TYPE is an error and fails validation
entries.rationale: an emitted type error cannot result in successful validation

entries.legacy_result: warns for reserved ports but omits them from duplicate tracking
entries.native_result: PIG_SERVICE_PORT_DUPLICATE detects duplicates while preserving the reserved warning
entries.rationale: reservation and uniqueness are independent rules

entries.legacy_result: skips address validation when pg_vip_enabled is true and an address exists
entries.rationale: enablement must not bypass validation of its required address

entries.legacy_result: validates object declarations only in PostgreSQL group vars
entries.native_result: validates explicitly declared users, databases, services, and HBA at global, group, and host scope
entries.rationale: native validation checks declarations where written without resolving effective vars

entries.legacy_result: safe_load rejects unknown or vault tags before semantic validation
entries.native_result: UNVERIFIABLE records an informational finding and does not inspect plaintext
entries.rationale: tagged and vault values remain lossless and opaque

entries.legacy_result: requires pg_vip_address in group vars whenever group VIP is enabled
entries.native_result: accepts a valid explicit address on every declared group host
entries.rationale: Citus-style per-host VIP declarations are complete without simulating Ansible effective vars
